summary: This joint resolution nullifies the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency's September 2024 rule on reviewing bank merger applications under the Bank Merger Act, preventing it from taking effect.

The bill addresses only the nullification of a bank merger regulation and has no provisions concerning tax rates, credits, deductions, or revenue collection.
